content:
tasha: Sentinel Health wants SOC2 cover page + ISO excerpt and a signed pen-test attestation for their vendor portal. They also ask to run a quick unauthenticated scan against staging. who owns docs + timeline?
rory: I can draft the attestation. we usually provide a one-page signed letter + scan cadence note. do they insist on full report or is attestation enough?
tasha: Procurement prefers the signed attestation only. they'll accept a redacted report if it's needed. they want everything by next Thu COB.
nate: Tech constraints: we allow scheduled unauth scans to a single hostname. need scope (hosts+ports), 72h lead for firewall rules, and a kill-switch contact. auth scans need an API test key and +24h to provision.
rory: upload instructions: do NOT email reports. use presigned S3 links or the secure evidence drive (SSO). I've uploaded the template: https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/templates/poc_pen_attestation_short.docx
compliance-bot: Attestation template available. Reminder: redaction policy = strip PoCs, internal IPs, and session tokens.
tasha: ok assigning: rory -> attestation + SOC2 cover page copy, nate -> staging window + host list, rory/nate -> if customer sends their PDF, forward to legal for review.
rory: I'll include a short POC data handling blurb (logs retained <=7 days). Will post final PDF here when signed. :thumbsup:
nate: If they request dedicated staging for scan isolation, ping me — that'll hit dedicated pricing and add ~5 business days.
tasha: i'll confirm scope with Sentinel and update. thanks all.
compliance-bot: When done, attach signed attestation to ticket #POC-9922 and mark evidence folder as "shared-with-sentinel".
